insight: A Y Combinator S26 company with 19k+ GitHub stars; source code is free for personal use under a commercial license.
name: screenpipe
tagline: Local-first 24/7 screen and audio memory your AI agents can search and act on.
description: Screenpipe continuously captures everything you see, say, and hear on your computer — extracting text via accessibility APIs and OCR and transcribing audio locally — to build a private, searchable memory of your digital life. That context feeds AI agents and 48+ app integrations, with on-device PII removal and all data stored locally by default. Cloud sync and managed deployment arrive in the paid tiers.

modelSupport.notes: Local models via Ollama or bring your own API keys; data stays on-device by default.

edge: 24/7 screen and audio capture that stays fully on-device, with PII scrubbing and 48+ app integrations feeding context to your AI agents.
cons: Commercial use requires a paid license
Always-on recording uses disk and CPU
